ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB=24\,cm$, $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$, point $D$ is on line segment $AC$, and $AD:CB=1:3$, what is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given $AB=24cm$ and $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$,\\
it follows that $AC=BC=\frac{1}{2}AB=12cm$,\\
given $AD\colon CB=1\colon 3$,\\
it follows that $AD=\frac{1}{3}CB=4cm$,\\
therefore, $CD=AC-AD=12-4=\boxed{8cm}$
